{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Gorilla Super Glue Gel, 20 Gram, Clear, (Pack of 10); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Adhesives fit my repair interests, but ten tubes are more than I currently need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Neosmuk Magnetic Hooks, Heavy Duty Earth Magnets with Hook for Refrigerator, Extra Strong Cruise Hook for Hanging, Magnetic Hanger for Cabins, Grill (Red, Pack of 10); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a specific magnetic hanging project in mind.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gorilla All Weather Outdoor Waterproof Duct Tape, UV and Temperature Resistant, 1.88" x 25 yd, Black, (Pack of 2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I have used Gorilla tape before, and this looks useful for weather-exposed repairs in a manageable quantity.
ItemID: NA; Title: Super Lube 56204 O-Ring Silicone Lubricant, Clear; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My hose-clamp purchases do not establish a current need to lubricate O-rings.
ItemID: NA; Title: TICONN 250Pcs Heat Shrink Wire Connectors, Waterproof Automotive Marine Electrical Terminals Kit, Crimp Connector Assortment, Ring Fork Spade Splices; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Waterproof connections would be useful for repair work, building on my previous purchase of crimp terminals.
ItemID: NA; Title: Professional Grade Aluminum Foil Tape - 2 Inch by 210 Feet (70 Yards) 3.6 Mil - High Temperature - Perfect for HVAC, Sealing & Patching Hot & Cold Air Ducts, Metal Repair, More!; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It relates to my recent duct-clamp purchase, but I would wait until I actually need to seal a duct joint.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sopoby 250PCS Solder Seal Wire Connectors Insulated Waterproof Electrical Wire Terminals Heat Shrink Solder Butt Connectors Solder Connector Kit for Automotive Marine; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my wiring interests, but I would choose the broader crimp assortment this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Loctite Epoxy Five Minute Instant Mix, Two 0.47-Fluid Ounce Syringes (1715208); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A small epoxy pack could suit repairs, but I have no immediate bonding task that calls for it.
ItemID: NA; Title: FRIMOONY Pegboard Hooks Assortment with Pegboard Bins, Peg Locks, for Organizing Various Tools, 80 Piece; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Buying repair supplies does not mean I have a pegboard or need this organizing kit.
ItemID: NA; Title: MILAPEAK 270 PCS Heat Shrink Tubing Kit - 3:1 Ratio Adhesive Lined, Marine Grade Shrink Wrap - Automotive Industrial Heat-Shrink Tubing - Black, Red; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Insulating wire repairs fits my interests, but I would defer this while choosing the heat-shrink connector kit."}
